entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ellen Dorothy Schulz Quillin was an American botanist, author, and museum director who helped establish the Witte Museum in San Antonio, Texas. She was the museum's director from 1926 to 1960. Quillin also wrote several field guides relating to plants in Texas.
